description:
The purpose of this Performance Work Statement (PWS) is to obtain secure documents and media destruction services for NAVSUP Headquarters and NAVSUP BSC in Mechanicsburg, PA. 

 The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, transportation, containers, and other resources necessary to securely collect, transport, destroy, and dispose of paper material only in accordance with applicable federal, Department of Defense, Department of the Navy, and local requirements. 

 The contractor shall provide recurring secure destruction services for materials identified by the Government for destruction. Materials only include paper records. 

 Services shall include: 

 
	 Furnishing secure, lockable collection containers. 
	 Scheduled pickup and/or on-site destruction. 
	 Secure handling and accountability of material from Government custody through final destruction. 
	 Destruction to a condition that prevents reconstruction or recovery of the information. 
	 Appropriate recycling or disposal of destroyed material. 
	 Providing a Certificate of Destruction following each service. 
 

  See Attachments - Solicitation and Wage Determination.
